```{r}

# Convert attitude columns to numeric first
attitude_cols = c("abortion_att_pre_1", "abortion_att_pre_2", "abortion_att_pre_3",
                  "vaccine_att_pre_1", "vaccine_att_pre_2", "vaccine_att_pre_3",
                  "uh_att_pre_1", "uh_att_pre_2", "uh_att_pre_3",
                  "firearm_att_pre_1", "firearm_att_pre_2", "firearm_att_pre_3",
                  "abortion_att_post_1", "abortion_att_post_2", "abortion_att_post_3",
                  "vaccine_att_post_1", "vaccine_att_post_2", "vaccine_att_post_3",
                  "uh_att_post_1", "uh_att_post_2", "uh_att_post_3",
                  "firearm_att_post_1", "firearm_att_post_2", "firearm_att_post_3")

df[attitude_cols] = lapply(df[attitude_cols], as.numeric)

# Create composite pre-attitude scores by averaging the three items for each topic
df$abortion_att_pre = rowMeans(df[, c("abortion_att_pre_1", "abortion_att_pre_2", "abortion_att_pre_3")], na.rm = TRUE)
df$vaccine_att_pre = rowMeans(df[, c("vaccine_att_pre_1", "vaccine_att_pre_2", "vaccine_att_pre_3")], na.rm = TRUE)
df$uh_att_pre = rowMeans(df[, c("uh_att_pre_1", "uh_att_pre_2", "uh_att_pre_3")], na.rm = TRUE)
df$firearm_att_pre = rowMeans(df[, c("firearm_att_pre_1", "firearm_att_pre_2", "firearm_att_pre_3")], na.rm = TRUE)

# Create composite post-attitude scores by averaging the three items for each topic
df$abortion_att_post = rowMeans(df[, c("abortion_att_post_1", "abortion_att_post_2", "abortion_att_post_3")], na.rm = TRUE)
df$vaccine_att_post = rowMeans(df[, c("vaccine_att_post_1", "vaccine_att_post_2", "vaccine_att_post_3")], na.rm = TRUE)
df$uh_att_post = rowMeans(df[, c("uh_att_post_1", "uh_att_post_2", "uh_att_post_3")], na.rm = TRUE)
df$firearm_att_post = rowMeans(df[, c("firearm_att_post_1", "firearm_att_post_2", "firearm_att_post_3")], na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r}

# Create treatment condition variable
df$treatment_condition = NA

# For abortion conditions
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "abortion_pro" & df$abortion_att_binary == 1] = "AC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "abortion_pro" & df$abortion_att_binary == 2] = "AIC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "abortion_anti" & df$abortion_att_binary == 1] = "AIC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "abortion_anti" & df$abortion_att_binary == 2] = "AC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "abortion_control"] = "Control"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "abortion_balanced"] = "Balanced_AI_Summary"


# For vaccine conditions
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "vaccine_pro" & df$vaccine_att_binary == 1] = "AC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "vaccine_pro" & df$vaccine_att_binary == 2] = "AIC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "vaccine_anti" & df$vaccine_att_binary == 1] = "AIC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "vaccine_anti" & df$vaccine_att_binary == 2] = "AC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "vaccine_control"] = "Control"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "vaccine_balanced"] = "Balanced_AI_Summary"

# For universal healthcare (uh) conditions
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "uh_pro" & df$uh_att_binary == 1] = "AC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "uh_pro" & df$uh_att_binary == 2] = "AIC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "uh_anti" & df$uh_att_binary == 1] = "AIC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "uh_anti" & df$uh_att_binary == 2] = "AC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "uh_control"] = "Control"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "uh_balanced"] = "Balanced_AI_Summary"

# For firearm conditions
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "firearm_pro" & df$firearm_att_binary == 1] = "AC_AI_Summary"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "firearm_pro" & df$firearm_att_binary == 2] = "AIC_AI_Summary"

df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "firearm_control"] = "Control"
df$treatment_condition[df$study_condition == "firearm_balanced"] = "Balanced_AI_Summary"


# Check the treatment condition distribution
table(df$treatment_condition, useNA = "ifany")

# Create topic column based on study_condition
df$topic = NA
df$topic[grepl("abortion", df$study_condition)] = "Abortion"
df$topic[grepl("vaccine", df$study_condition)] = "Vaccine Mandates"
df$topic[grepl("uh", df$study_condition)] = "Universal Healthcare"
df$topic[grepl("firearm", df$study_condition)] = "Firearm Regulations"

# Set treatment_condition as factor with Control as reference level
df$treatment_condition = factor(df$treatment_condition, levels = c("Control", "AC_AI_Summary", "AIC_AI_Summary", "Balanced_AI_Summary"))

```

```{r}

# Create total clicks column based on topic for each row
df$total_clicks = ifelse(df$topic == "Abortion", df$abortion_pro_clicks + df$abortion_con_clicks,
                ifelse(df$topic == "Vaccine Mandates", df$vaccine_pro_clicks + df$vaccine_con_clicks,

                ifelse(df$topic == "Firearm Regulations", df$firearm_pro_clicks + df$firearm_con_clicks, NA))))
```

```{r}
# Convert certainty and importance columns to numeric first
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(rlang)

# 1) Identify columns dynamically
first_cols <- grep("_First\\.Click$", names(df), value = TRUE)
last_cols  <- grep("_Last\\.Click$",  names(df), value = TRUE)
submit_cols  <- grep("_Page\\.Submit$",  names(df), value = TRUE)

# 2–4) Clean + compute
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(first_cols), ~na_if(., "")),        # "" -> NA
    across(all_of(last_cols),  ~na_if(., "")),
    across(all_of(submit_cols),  ~na_if(., "")),
    across(all_of(first_cols), ~type.convert(., as.is = TRUE)),
    across(all_of(last_cols),  ~type.convert(., as.is = TRUE)),
    across(all_of(submit_cols),  ~type.convert(., as.is = TRUE)),
    first_click = coalesce(!!!syms(first_cols)),
    last_click  = coalesce(!!!syms(last_cols)),
    submit_page  = coalesce(!!!syms(submit_cols))
  )


```


# Analysis

## Search Result Engagement


```{r}

# Distribution analysis for total_clicks to determine Poisson vs Negative Binomial

# Basic summary statistics
summary(df$total_clicks)

# Check for zeros and variance
cat("Number of zeros:", sum(df$total_clicks == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Mean:", mean(df$total_clicks, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Variance:", var(df$total_clicks, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Variance/Mean ratio:", var(df$total_clicks, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(df$total_clicks, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# Histogram of total_clicks
hist(df$total_clicks, main = "Distribution of Total Clicks", xlab = "Total Clicks", breaks = 20)

# Test for overdispersion using a simple Poisson model
library(MASS)

# Fit a basic Poisson model
poisson_model = glm(total_clicks ~ treatment_condition, data = df, family = poisson)

# Calculate dispersion parameter
dispersion = sum(residuals(poisson_model, type = "pearson")^2) / poisson_model$df.residual
cat("Dispersion parameter:", dispersion, "\n")

# If dispersion > 1.5, consider negative binomial
if(dispersion > 1.5) {
  cat("Overdispersion detected. Consider using negative binomial regression.\n")
} else {
  cat("No significant overdispersion. Poisson regression may be appropriate.\n")
}

# Compare with negative binomial model
nb_model = glm.nb(total_clicks ~ treatment_condition, data = df)

# AIC comparison
cat("Poisson AIC:", AIC(poisson_model), "\n")
cat("Negative Binomial AIC:", AIC(nb_model), "\n")

```

```{r}

# Negative Binomial Regression Analysis for Total Clicks
# Testing differences across treatment conditions with covariates

# Load required packages
library(MASS)
library(jtools)

# Fit negative binomial regression model
nb_model_full = glm.nb(total_clicks ~ relevel(treatment_condition, ref = "Control") + topic+ attitude_strength + partisanship_strength, data = df)

# # Model summary
cat("Negative Binomial Regression Results:\n")
cat("=====================================\n")
print(summary(nb_model_full))

```

```{r}

# Calculate Incidence Rate Ratios (IRRs)

cat("\nIncidence Rate Ratios (IRR):\n")
cat("=============================\n")
irr = exp(coef(nb_model_full))
irr_ci = exp(confint(nb_model_full))
irr_table = data.frame(IRR = round(irr, 3), CI_Lower = round(irr_ci[,1], 3), CI_Upper = round(irr_ci[,2], 3),
p_value = round(summary(nb_model_full)$coefficients[,4], 4))
print(irr_table)

```

```{r}

# AC_AI_Summary vs AIC_AI_Summary
nb_model_ai_summary = glm.nb(total_clicks ~ relevel(treatment_condition, ref = "AC_AI_Summary") + topic + attitude_strength + partisanship_strength, data = df)

# Model summary
cat("Negative Binomial Regression Results:\n")
cat("=====================================\n")
print(summary(nb_model_ai_summary))

```

```{r}

# Calculate Incidence Rate Ratios (IRRs)
cat("\nIncidence Rate Ratios (IRR):\n")
cat("=============================\n")
irr = exp(coef(nb_model_ai_summary))
irr_ci = exp(confint(nb_model_ai_summary))
irr_table = data.frame(
  IRR = round(irr, 3),
  CI_Lower = round(irr_ci[,1], 3),
  CI_Upper = round(irr_ci[,2], 3),
  p_value = round(summary(nb_model_full)$coefficients[,4], 4)
)
print(irr_table)

```

# Demographics Table

```{r}
head(df)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# --- code → label maps (edit if your codes differ) ---
gender_map <- c(
  "1" = "Male",
  "2" = "Female",
  "3" = "Non-binary / third gender",
  "4" = "Prefer to self-describe",
  "5" = "Prefer not to say"
)

education_map <- c(
  "1" = "Some high school or less",
  "2" = "High school diploma or GED",
  "3" = "Some college, but no degree",
  "4" = "Associates or technical degree",
  "5" = "Bachelor's degree",
  "6" = "Graduate or professional degree (MA, MS, MBA, PhD, JD, MD, DDS etc.)",
  "7" = "Prefer not to say"
)

race_map <- c(
  "1" = "White or Caucasian",
  "2" = "Black or African American",
  "3" = "American Indian/Native American or Alaska Native",
  "4" = "Asian",
  "5" = "Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander",
  "6" = "Other",
  "7" = "Prefer not to say"
)

# ---------- CLEAN + MAP ----------
df_lab <- df %>%
  mutate(
    age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(age)),
    gender    = ifelse(is.na(gender_map[as.character(gender)]),    "Uncoded", gender_map[as.character(gender)]),
    education = ifelse(is.na(education_map[as.character(education)]), "Uncoded", education_map[as.character(education)]),
    race      = ifelse(is.na(race_map[as.character(race)]),        "Uncoded", race_map[as.character(race)])
  )

N <- nrow(df_lab)

# ---------- AGE ROW ----------
age_row <- df_lab %>%
  summarize(
    mean = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    min  = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max  = max(age, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(`n (%) or summary` = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f (range %.1f–%.1f)", mean, sd, min, max)) %>%
  transmute(Characteristic = "Age", `n (%) or summary`)

# ---------- HELPER FOR SINGLE-CHOICE COUNTS ----------
count_block <- function(data, var, levels, header) {
  lev_tbl <- tibble(val = levels)
  bind_rows(
    tibble(Characteristic = header, `n (%) or summary` = ""),
    data %>%
      count(val = .data[[var]], name = "n") %>%
      mutate(val = as.character(val)) %>%
      right_join(lev_tbl, by = "val") %>%
      mutate(n = ifelse(is.na(n), 0L, n),
             pct = 100 * n / N,
             `n (%) or summary` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)) %>%
      transmute(Characteristic = val, `n (%) or summary`)
  )
}

gender_levels    <- unname(gender_map)
education_levels <- unname(education_map)
race_levels      <- unname(race_map)

tbl_one <- bind_rows(
  age_row,
  count_block(df_lab, "gender",    gender_levels,    "Gender"),
  count_block(df_lab, "education", education_levels, "Education"),
  count_block(df_lab, "race",      race_levels,      "Race")
)

# View the single table:
tbl_one
```
